svg.aria-label: Zalo + Telegram Finance App: Text the bot "pho 45k" and it lands in your budget. Telegram and Zalo bots: a line of text or a receipt photo becomes a draft you confirm. Wallets, categories, monthly budgets with alerts, stats; Vietnamese and English. Built solo in 29 reviewed PRs: 366 automated tests, 33 bugs found and fixed. Live: sochitieu-btl.vercel.app Stack: React, TypeScript, Express, MongoDB, PaddleOCR.
